parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
Verify cold-start minimum startup voltage and bus surge ceiling.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning.
For boost converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS562201DDCR: 3.3 µH p.13 vs TPS563201DDCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS562201DDCR specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS563201DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
engineering_verdict: TPS562201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to recommended inductor value differs >20%; current rating or switch-limit basis differs. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 580 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.6), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.3 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), and Iq is 120 µA (p.5) vs 120 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 90.8 vs 92.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
